constants.SLOW_POLL: 8s (when price far from all trigger levels)

implementation.logic: For each signal, compute abs(price - entry/sl/tp). If ANY distance <= NEAR_THRESHOLD → FAST(1s). Else → SLOW(8s).
implementation.rate_limit_failsafe: On price fetch failure, rate_limit_until set 30s into future. All cycles during cooldown use SLOW_POLL.

live_verification.before: API calls every 1s — ~60 calls/min (TwelveData 429 on every request)
live_verification.after: API calls every 8s — ~7.5 calls/min (within TwelveData free tier: 8 credits/min)

verdict: ALL 153 TESTS PASS — Adaptive polling reduces API calls 87% while preserving 1s precision near triggers
